dhpak2.5:1.1: The English story title aligns with the Pāli title. The romanized title Mahākassapattheravatthu was removed because it has no separate passage in the story text.
dhpak2.5:3.2: ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā says the elder increased the light; the former English said that he ‘developed insight,’ a different action.
dhpak2.5:3.3: The editorial heading ‘His Mind Surveys’ was removed because it has no separate corresponding passage in the local Pāli story.
dhpak2.5:3.4: cavanake upapajjanake describes beings passing away and arising. The first English account had reversed this sequence.
dhpak2.5:4.3: cutūpapātaṃ describes passing away and arising; the former English called it ‘the rising and falling.’ The corrected account follows the Pāli sequence.
dhpak2.5:4.4: sattānaṃ cutūpapāto nāma buddhañāṇenapi aparicchinno says beings' passing away and arising cannot be fully reckoned even by Buddha-knowledge. The former English instead said unlimited knowledge of this is only within a Buddha's knowledge.
dhpak2.5:4.5: mātukucchiyaṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā mātāpitaro ajānāpetvā cavanasattānaṃ describes beings who pass away after conception in the womb without their parents knowing; the former English made conception itself the unknown event.
dhpak2.5:4.10: obhāsaṃ pharitvā says the Teacher spread radiance; the former English introduced a ‘radiant image of himself.’
dhpak2.5:5.1: The repeated Pāli transcription of verse 28 was removed because it has no separate corresponding passage in the local Pāli story.
dhpak2.5:6.1: The Pāli explanation of verse 28 has no English translation and remains Pāli-only under this paragraph.
dhpak2.5:7.1: The appended ‘221:’ sutta note was removed because it has no separate corresponding passage in the local Pāli story.
dhpak2.5:8.1: The Pāli closing title Mahākassapattheravatthu pañcamaṃ is Pāli-only and has no English key.
